mobbin:278b5778-83b4-4ad3-a5ea-296d26fa2.summary: From an empty week calendar, open New event, fill title, date and time with a live grid preview, adjust duration, and Save beside optional participants, location and Repeats.
steps: Title set with live grid preview
steal: Save stays disabled until a title exists; the default slot is 30 minutes with a live untitled or titled block on the week grid (screens 2 to 3).
Sidebar create keeps the week grid visible, and the draft block updates as date and time change for a manual conflict scan (screens 3 to 8).
Core fields (title, date, start to end) come first; All day, Repeats, participants, location, description and color stay optional on the same panel (screens 2 and 6 to 7).
avoid: There is no automated conflict or availability check while adding participants, only visual overlap on an empty grid.
mobbin:278b5778-83b4-4ad3-a5ea-296d26fa2.fit: Scheduling: good cheap full-form-beside-calendar for simple sessions (scenario title, room as location, faculty and learners as participants). The Repeats switch is the series entry, not flexi rostering.

refero:1928.summary: Open a recurring Marketing All-Hands, choose Yes/No/Maybe, confirm scope Only this event versus All events, and see Maybe highlighted with a striped event block.
steps: RSVP scope: this vs all events
steal: Inline Yes / No / Maybe on the event sidebar is for the invitee, with the organizer labeled (screen 2).
After the reply, a striped fill on the selected occurrence shows the response on the grid (screen 4).
avoid: The 'Only this event' / 'All events' scope dialog duplicates Amie/Motion series-scope already covered elsewhere; do not treat it as a new pattern (screen 3).
refero:1928.fit: Scheduling: learner or faculty invitee reply for session series. Reuse Yes/No/Maybe plus a visual response on the grid; borrow series-scope from prior course research, not this capture.
